Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking a System Engineering Specialist to join our Fintech & Product Enablement team in Bucharest, Romania.
In this role, you will implement, administer, maintain and optimise the infrastructure supporting Vodafone applications hosted across on-premises and public cloud environments, with a strong focus on AWS . You will contribute to the availability, performance, security and scalability of business-critical services while providing technical support across both infrastructure and application layers.
The role combines cloud infrastructure administration, DevOps practices, microservices release management, observability and production support. You will work closely with Development and DevOps teams to diagnose and resolve incidents and help maintain reliable services with a targeted availability of at least 99.9% .
 What You’ll Do
Administer, monitor and maintain cloud infrastructure and associated resources, ensuring service availability, performance, security and scalability 
Coordinate and oversee the deployment of new microservices releases across testing and production environments 
Follow established release processes to minimise operational risk and maintain service availability during production changes 
Collaborate with Development and DevOps teams to investigate, diagnose and resolve infrastructure and application incidents 
Continuously monitor and analyse application infrastructure to identify and address operational issues 
Develop and maintain the integration infrastructure supporting existing and future applications 
Support the evolution and expansion of the wider application ecosystem 
Administer and support applications and infrastructure that are critical to business processes 
Ensure agreed customer KPIs and SLAs are met for applications and infrastructure under management 
Maintain application availability and reliability at a minimum target of 99.9% 
Deliver agreed operational activities, projects and requests according to established priorities and deadlines 
Support successful releases and production changes while minimising disruption to service continuity 
Maintain accurate and up-to-date technical documentation in line with organisational processes and standards 
Participate, where required, in planned or unplanned interventions outside standard working hours, including on-call activities and support for critical production incidents 
 Who You Are
You have completed higher education in an IT-related field and have at least two years of IT experience 
You have at least two years of experience designing, implementing and administering on-premises and/or public cloud infrastructure 
You have practical experience with AWS environments and cloud infrastructure administration 
You have experience with containerisation and orchestration platforms, security services, monitoring, automation and configuration management 
You are familiar with scripting languages such as Bash, Python and PowerShell, using them to automate infrastructure administration and operational processes 
You have practical knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Git, GitLab, GitHub, Jenkins, FluxCD and ArgoCD 
You have experience with modern monitoring and observability tools such as Instana, Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog 
You have experience administering, operating and hosting web applications and their associated services 
You understand and can apply DevOps principles in public cloud environments 
You have experience supporting business-critical applications and infrastructure 
You understand the application and implementation of ITIL, SOX and IT security policies and procedures 
You have practical knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban 
You are comfortable working in a dynamic operational environment, managing several priorities while responding effectively to incidents and service requirements 
You are able to participate in planned or unplanned activities outside standard working hours and in on-call support where required 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/ VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget 
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Loyalty Programme
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
Getting in on the ground floor of a technology changing company
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
 Through this role, you will have opportunities to further develop:
Cloud infrastructure engineering and administration in AWS and on-premises environments 
DevOps engineering and automation practices 
CI/CD implementation and management using tools including Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub, FluxCD and ArgoCD 
Infrastructure and operational automation using Bash, Python and PowerShell 
Monitoring, observability and performance management using Instana, Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog 
Release management for microservices across testing and production environments 
Production incident investigation, troubleshooting and service recovery 
Administration and support of business-critical applications and infrastructure 
Operational practices aligned with ITIL, SOX, security requirements, KPIs and SLAs 
Cross-functional collaboration with Development and DevOps teams

 Join Us

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
